body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Neogen Chemicals (NEOGEN). Probability 0.43 (naive sector base rate 0.44) that: Neogen Chemicals (NEOGEN) working-capital days <= 180 at 31-Mar-2027. Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.436 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'balance_sheet' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=39); SAC -0.065 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.43. Evidence: call of 2026-11-02: "we would be somewhere, around 180 days, is what we are targetting by the end of the current financial year" (Q2FY27). Resolution: YES if the company-reported working-capital days at FY27 end <= 180 (ceiling, strict). Source: company Q3/Q4 FY27 filings, presentations and call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-30; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).

data.adjustment_applied: p0 = 0.436 (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'balance_sheet' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=39); SAC -0.065 x w 0.130 (N=3) -> P_cred = 0.43
data.adjustment_rule: P_cred = clip(p0 + N/(N+20) x SAC, 0.05, 0.95); SAC = mean(y - p0(group)) over the company's resolved past promises (strict: delivered=1, else 0); N<3 -> P_cred = p0. P_base = p0.
data.base_rate_reasoning: Naive forecaster = leave-one-out strict delivery rate of Chemicals peers in group 'balance_sheet' (pooled all cohort + T&D companies, group 'balance_sheet' (sector pool n=7 < 8), n=39). No company-specific information.

data.resolution_rule: YES if the company-reported working-capital days at FY27 end <= 180 (ceiling, strict).
